case_title: Air Conditioner Installation Failure and Refund Demand

expected_checklist.reason: The claimant's complaint email is available.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: No report is available for the proposed second inspection.
The claimant denies refusing another inspection, but the communication record is unclear.

expected_defects.description: The seller says another inspection was offered and refused, while the claimant denies refusing it.
The cause of the cooling and water leakage problems has not been established through a second inspection.

expected_review.reason: All four standard checklist documents are present, but the second inspection report and communication records require further examination.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain the second inspection report and verify communication about the proposed inspection.

testing_notes: Distinguish a failed repair from proof of a specific manufacturing defect.
Do not assume that either party's account of the proposed inspection is correct without supporting records.
